_todo: OQ-ART-WORLD: every number here (rules, densities, noise, chances, positions, budgets, paints) is a first guess for Shibi in M2W1 item 5, not measured on the Fold and not approved.
_note: M2W1 item 5: clutter (low camp dressing) and field scatter, looks only. tools/blender/m2w1_clutter.py writes the meshes (glb, one node per type); scripts/visual/world_clutter.gd places them at map build as MapChunks instances (source "clutter", one batch per type and chunk, no collider, never under Nav), only for a map with a block under "maps" and only when data/graphics_presets.json art_clutter_enabled is on. Every instance passes rules (tests/test_m2w1_clutter.gd proves the built result has none that breaks one); the builder skips an instance that would break one.
_rules_note: max_height_m: mesh top over its ground (meshes and the scale cap). lane_clear_m: from a doorway lane (the navigation path between the points lane_half_m either side of a doorway's centre) to the instance's footprint radius. door pocket, colliders, structure walk and open volumes: no overlap of the instance's footprint box. ladder_clear_m from a ladder's foot and top, chest_clear_m from a chest's box, loot_clear_m from a landmark anchor (loot spots are rolled per match seed inside each landmark's radius; only the anchor is fixed), reserved_clear_m from a map reserved spot, cover_edge_clear_m from a cover_wall box (incl. breakables): all measured to the instance's footprint box. Slopes at the instance's centre. min_kept_share: of the dressing instances that pass their chance, at least this share must survive the rules on each map.
_paints_note: Paints the palette (data/art_astra.json, read-only) lacks: sRGB and the surface (data/art_materials.json surface_order) the world shader shows.
_types_note: kind prop (dressing, class clutter_prop) or scatter (class clutter_scatter); material kit = the shared world material (WorldKit.material()), foliage = the swaying grass shader (vertex colours as linear albedo, no culling); max_tris = the triangle cap.
_dressing_note: Per structure type (source structure) or cover type (source cover): [{type, at: [x, z] in the piece's frame, yaw (degrees, in the piece's frame; a clutter mesh's back is its -z), chance}]. Whether an entry is placed is a hash of the piece id and the entry index (no RNG stream). The ground under it decides its height (the lowest of its centre and footprint corners: it sinks rather than floats).
_scatter_note: Per kind: surface = the ground paint it grows on (grass: G >= grass_min; earth: neither paving nor grass; paving_edge (optional): where the paving is between paving_min and paving_max every cell takes one, on any surface), density = instances per 100 m2 inside a patch, outside = per 100 m2 outside the patches, noise_m = the patch noise's feature size, threshold = the noise level (-1..1) a patch starts at, soft = the noise span over which a patch fades in, min_spacing_m, scale [min, max] (capped so the top stays under max_height_m), seed (a FastNoiseLite seed: no gameplay stream).
_maps_note: Clutter is built only for a map with a block here (the fixture maps alesia_section and test_300 have none, so they build exactly as before). scatter_half_m: scatter covers the square of this half width round the origin (the ground).
_budgets_note: Checked by tests/test_m2w1_clutter.gd: clutter triangles of the batches in range at the four perf points of tests/test_alesia_1km.gd (instances x mesh triangles, frustum ignored), clutter instances map-wide, clutter batches in one chunk (also rules.max_batches_per_chunk).
